**Arthur Chung’s available information / subjective perspective:**

- Arthur knows he is Arthur Chung, a plumber with a doctorate, and that he works professionally with Teresa Ortega, a medical assistant, on community service projects.
- During the current project, he observes Teresa working hard and appearing overwhelmed. He feels concerned for her well-being and decides to offer help.
- He tells Teresa he noticed she seems overwhelmed and asks if he can help. He hears Teresa say she thinks she can manage but there is a lot to do.
- Arthur tells her it is important to take care of herself and offers to help so they can finish faster. He hears Teresa accept help with organizing medical supplies. They begin.
- Arthur believes Teresa is hesitant to accept help because she wants to prove her capability. He feels empathetic and reassures her that accepting help does not mean she is not capable.
- He hears Teresa say she appreciates it but wants to show she can do it by herself. Arthur tells her teamwork can be more effective and it is not about proving anything. He hears Teresa agree and say she sometimes needs reminding. He tells her they are in it together and he supports her.
- Arthur believes Teresa is still struggling. He feels frustrated that his help is not yielding results and intends to find another way to support her without making her feel inadequate.
- He tells Teresa he sees things are still tough and that she is doing a great job. He hears Teresa say it has been busy and she feels behind.
- Arthur proposes working together instead of just helping her, so they can share the load. He hears Teresa agree.
- Arthur believes working together will ease Teresa’s burden and improve efficiency. He feels hopeful and intends to fully commit to the collaborative approach.
- He tells Teresa he is hopeful about the collaborative approach. He hears Teresa say it already feels less overwhelming. Arthur suggests he handles inventory while Teresa manages patient records, with regular check-ins. He hears Teresa agree and say she is glad they are doing this together.
- Arthur believes their collaboration has strengthened their professional relationship. He feels satisfied and intends to maintain this collaborative approach in future projects.
- He tells Teresa their teamwork paid off and proposes continuing it. He hears Teresa agree, call it fantastic, and say they are more efficient and effective as a team. Arthur says he looks forward to their next project. He hears Teresa thank him for being a supportive colleague.
